notes: Twinblade Paladin, printed: 'As long as you have 25 or more life, this creature has double strike.' I start at 22 life and my Healer of the Glade takes me to exactly 25: the Paladin gets its counter (4/4) and, now having double strike, deals 4 + 4 = 8 to the opponent (22 to 14) when it attacks.
